paid_action: Unknown for the Ambassador Program. Referrals Program (help centre): referred user registers via the referral link, completes KYC, tops up by bank transfer (other methods ineligible) and makes at least 3 card purchases of a minimum amount (page states 'at least five euros (€10)' — internally inconsistent).

Ambassador Program conditions unknown.
